title: what would have been
description: 과거 사실에 반대되는 가정을 할 때 쓰는 표현으로, "~이었을 것", "무엇이 되었을까", "~했을 상황"을 의미합니다.
주로 후회, 가정, 대안을 이야기할 때 사용됩니다.
예: "What would have been different if..." (만약 ~했다면 무엇이 달라졌을까)
또는 "That would have been perfect."처럼 실현되지 않은 이상적인 상황을 말할 때도 자주 씁니다.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I only got 70 on the final. I should have studied more.
lines.meaning: 기말고사 70점밖에 못 받았어. 더 공부했어야 했는데.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah... what would have been your score if you had reviewed the last chapter?
lines.meaning: 그렇지... 마지막 챕터 복습했으면 몇 점이나 나왔을까?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We lost by just one point in the last second.
lines.meaning: 마지막 순간에 1점 차로 졌어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I keep thinking about what would have been if that free throw had gone in.
lines.meaning: 그 자유투가 들어갔으면 어떻게 됐을지 계속 생각나.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We chose the cheaper supplier and now the quality is terrible.
lines.meaning: 싼 업체를 골랐더니 지금 품질이 엉망이야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. What would have been the better choice in the long run?
lines.meaning: 맞아. 장기적으로 보면 뭐가 더 나은 선택이었을까?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Probably the more expensive one. That would have been worth it.
lines.meaning: 아마 더 비싼 쪽이었을 거야. 그게 결국 이득이었을 텐데.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you ever wonder what would have been if we had met earlier?
lines.meaning: 우리가 더 일찍 만났으면 어떻게 됐을지 생각해 본 적 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sometimes. Maybe we would have been together much longer.
lines.meaning: 가끔. 아마 훨씬 오래 사귀었을지도 모르지.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The flight got canceled and we ended up staying home.
lines.meaning: 비행기가 취소돼서 결국 집에 있었어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. What would have been a perfect weekend trip turned into nothing.
lines.meaning: 그렇지. 완벽한 주말 여행이 될 뻔했는데 결국 아무것도 아니게 됐어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I turned down that job offer last year.
lines.meaning: 작년에 그 일자리 제안을 거절했었어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Really? What would have been different if you had taken it?
lines.meaning: 진짜? 그때 받아들였으면 지금이랑 뭐가 달라졌을까?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably a higher salary... and a lot more stress.
lines.meaning: 아마 연봉은 더 높았겠지만... 스트레스도 훨씬 많았을 거야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I didn't like the ending. It felt too sudden.
lines.meaning: 결말이 별로였어. 너무 갑작스러웠달까.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Same. What would have been a better ending for the main character?
lines.meaning: 나도. 주인공한테 더 나았을 결말은 뭐였을까?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We had to cancel the outdoor wedding because of the storm.
lines.meaning: 폭풍 때문에 야외 결혼식을 취소해야 했어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. What would have been a beautiful ceremony became a rushed indoor event.
lines.meaning: 그렇지. 아름다웠을 식장이 급하게 실내로 바뀌어 버렸지.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I sold those stocks too early. They doubled after that.
lines.meaning: 그 주식 너무 일찍 팔았어. 그 후에 두 배가 됐거든.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ouch. What would have been your profit if you had held on a bit longer?
lines.meaning: 아이고. 조금만 더 들고 있었으면 수익이 얼마였을까?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: At least three times more. That would have been life-changing.
lines.meaning: 최소 세 배는 됐을 거야. 인생이 바뀌었을 정도였지.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sometimes I wonder if I made the right choice moving here.
lines.meaning: 가끔 여기로 이사 온 게 옳은 선택이었는지 궁금해.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Well, what would have been waiting for you if you had stayed?
lines.meaning: 그럼 거기 그대로 있었으면 뭐가 기다리고 있었을까?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably the same old routine. Maybe this was better after all.
lines.meaning: 아마 똑같은 일상뿐이었겠지. 결국 이게 더 나았을지도 몰라.
